facts.text: Leslieville sits on a railway bridge over Queen Street East, straddling the boundary between Riverside to the west and Leslieville to the east.
The Ontario Line will run from Exhibition GO Station in the south to Don Valley station in the north, linking with Line 5 Eglinton.
Plans for a “Downtown Relief Line” first appeared in the 1980s to relieve congestion on Yonge and extend east‑end subway service.
In April 2019 the Ontario government unveiled the Ontario Line, largely following the earlier Relief Line route and station locations.
Initial cost estimates for the Ontario Line were $10.9 billion, with a target completion date of 2027.
Tunnelling for the line began in April 2026 using two tunnel‑boring machines named Libby and Corkie after Liberty Village and Corktown.
